federal.title: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 (post-Bostock)
federal.citation: 42 U.S.C. § 2000e et seq.; Bostock v. Clayton County, 590 U.S. ___ (2020)
federal.summary: Federal employment discrimination law prohibits discrimination on the basis of sex, which the Supreme Court has held includes discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation and gender identity. Applies to workplace incidents involving an employer or coworker.

federal.title: Fair Housing Act
federal.summary: Federal fair housing law prohibits discrimination on the basis of sex; HUD interprets this to include gender identity. Applies to rental, sale, and financing of housing.

federal.title: Section 1557 of the Affordable Care Act
federal.summary: Federal civil rights law prohibiting discrimination in covered health programs and activities on the basis of sex, including gender identity.

federal.title: Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972
federal.summary: Federal law prohibiting sex-based discrimination, sexual harassment, and sexual violence in any education program or activity receiving federal financial assistance. Enforced by the U.S. Department of Education Office for Civil Rights (OCR).
